title: Card ship's fetch gets the same timeout as the throwaway's
notes: GitHub issue #381 (gh issue view 381); the PR body says Closes #381. src/main/ship/ship-flow.ts:52 runs the ship's git fetch with the project's queue held and no timeout, so a stalled connection blocks every later pane run --worktree, ship and review in that project. Give it the 60 s cap #378 gave the throwaway's fetch (fetchedBase in src/main/actions/worktree/make.ts); reuse that code rather than copying it.
